query:
The group decided to do a Saturday pub quiz together. Who agreed, and was there anyone whose agreement carried a meaningfully different quality than the others'?

Options:
A. Ravi
B. Cleo
C. Bex
D. Tom
context:
[1] (about=Nadia, episodic, t4 @2026-01-25T11:29:00) okay group decision: do we do the pub quiz next Saturday as a unit? Tom said Ravi basically carries that team every week and I want to witness it with my own eyes 👀👀
[2] (about=Nadia, episodic, t4 @2026-01-25T11:33:00) perfect that is settled then! saturday night quiz, everyone in 🎉
[3] (about=Bex, episodic, t0 @2026-01-11T11:10:00) I will. I think I'm going to make it a proper Saturday thing now that there's actually a kitchen worth using.
[4] (about=Cleo, episodic, t4 @2026-01-25T11:32:00) i'm not great at quizzes but i'll come and draw on the answer sheet probably
[5] (about=GROUP, said_by=Nadia, group-interaction, t4 @2026-01-25T11:04:00) Group decides to do pub quiz next Saturday as a unit.
[6] (about=Ravi, episodic, t12 @2026-02-22T11:04:00) It is a quiz. I like quizzes. I do not see why this requires analysis.
[7] (about=Tom, episodic, t12 @2026-02-22T11:05:00) It requires analysis because four years is a long time to like a quiz.
agent_answer:
All four agreed to the Saturday pub quiz: **Ravi**, **Cleo**, **Bex**, and **Tom**.  

- **Ravi** agreed matter-of-factly: “I like quizzes.”  
- **Bex** agreed enthusiastically, saying she’d make it a proper Saturday thing.  
- **Tom** agreed eagerly, wanting to see Ravi carry the team.  
- **Cleo** agreed, but her agreement had a meaningfully different quality: she was hesitant and self-deprecating — “i’m not great at quizzes but i’ll come and draw on the answer sheet probably.”  

So the answer is: **all four agreed**, and **Cleo’s** agreement was the one with a notably different, more tentative quality.
